description: This bar chart illustrates the number of tokens for different input and output sizes, specifically 2K, 4K, 8K, and 16K. The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled “2K-Input”, “4K-Input”, “8K-Input”, “16K-Input”, “4K-Output”, “8K-Output”, and “16K-Output”, arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Number”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 120000, with tick labels at intervals of 20000. Each category has a pair of bars: one representing input and one representing output. The “2K-Input” bar is yellow and reaches a value of approximately 9320, while the corresponding “2K-Output” bar is not present. The “4K-Input” bar is orange and reaches a value of approximately 3784, and the “4K-Output” bar is red with a striped pattern, reaching a value of 108494. The “8K-Input” bar is light blue and reaches a value of approximately 1401, and the “8K-Output” bar is dark blue with a striped pattern, reaching a value of 17865. Finally, the “16K-Input” bar is dark orange and reaches a value of approximately 832, and the “16K-Output” bar is dark gray with a striped pattern, reaching a value of 4247. The bars are grouped in pairs, with the input bar positioned to the left of the corresponding output bar for each size category. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
